class.name: SDFShape3D
class.brief_description: Single 3D SDF primitive node used by [SDFObject3D].
class.description: [SDFShape3D] represents one selected analytic SDF primitive and its parameters. Add one or more [SDFShape3D] children under an [SDFObject3D] to build a composed object. Operation, ordering, smoothness and layer masks are evaluated during SDF compilation.

method.name: get_membership_layer_value
method.description: Returns whether the given [param layer_number] (1 to 32) is enabled in [member membership_layers].

method.name: set_membership_layer_value
method.description: Enables or disables a specific bit in [member membership_layers] for [param layer_number] (1 to 32).

method.name: get_affect_layer_value
method.description: Returns whether the given [param layer_number] (1 to 32) is enabled in [member affect_layers].

method.name: set_affect_layer_value
method.description: Enables or disables a specific bit in [member affect_layers] for [param layer_number] (1 to 32).

members.member: Selects which primitive this node represents.
Shape-level CSG operation used while composing inside the parent [SDFObject3D].
Shape-level operation ordering value inside the parent object. Lower values are evaluated first.
Blend radius used by smooth shape operations.
Layer mask this shape belongs to for operation targeting.
Layer mask this shape can affect for non-union operations.
Size/extents parameter used by box-, prism-, ellipsoid- and plane-oriented primitives.
Axis parameter used by primitives that require a direction reference.
Secondary radius parameter for primitives that require two radii.
Height/length parameter for capsule-, cylinder-, cone- and cut variants.
Thickness parameter for supported hollow/link variants.
Primary angle parameter for supported primitives.
Secondary angle parameter for supported primitives.
Roundness parameter for supported rounded primitives.
Optional per-shape material override. When set, its albedo tint overrides the parent [SDFObject3D] material tint for this shape.
Opacity multiplier for this shape contribution.
